/*getShopCartSrcSql_02*/
SELECT
X.TEXT3, Y.TEXT1 temp, X.CODE, X.CODE||'['|| X.TEXT1 ||']' as TEXT1
FROM ICOMCOD2 X, ICOMCOD2 Y WHERE X.COMPANY_CODE = #{st_buyer} AND X.TYPE IN ('P001','P002','M014') AND LENGTH(X.CODE) = 4 AND Y.TYPE IN ('P001','P002','M014') AND X.COMPANY_CODE = Y.COMPANY_CODE AND X.TEXT3 = Y.CODE AND X.TEXT3 = #{st_plant} ORDER BY X.TEXT3

/*getShopCartSrcSql_03*/
SELECT
CODE, CODE||'['||TEXT1||']' as TEXT1
FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{st_buyer} AND TYPE IN ('P001','P002','M014') AND LENGTH(CODE) = 8 ORDER BY TEXT3,CODE, TEXT1
